400 Bad Request when uploading a file with invalid purpose

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

do {
    let _req = try LiterLlm.createFileRequestFromJson("{\"file\":\"data.jsonl\",\"purpose\":\"invalid-purpose\"}")
    guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
    let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
    _ = try await _client.createFile(_req)
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
